head_coach.name: Miroslav Koubek
head_coach.play_style_summary: A pragmatic, defensively resilient, and physically dominant direct style. Heavy reliance on route-one aerial football towards a target man to win second balls, alongside structured transitions, and intensive set-piece execution (scoring more set-piece goals than any other European team in qualifying). Out of possession, the team drops into a compact 5-3-2 defensive low-block with disciplined man-to-man marking.

key_players.name: Ladislav Krejčí
key_players.performance_stats: National team captain who anchors the backline. Recorded 28 Premier League appearances (2721 minutes) in the 25/26 season. Won 35 possessions in his team's defensive third during World Cup qualifying—the highest in UEFA—while providing a massive aerial threat on set pieces.

key_players.name: Patrik Schick
key_players.performance_stats: Standout goalscoring talisman with elite movement inside the penalty area. Registered 9 goals and 3 assists in 21 Bundesliga matches for Bayer Leverkusen during the 25/26 season, presenting an elite aerial and tactical focal point for the offense.

key_players.name: Tomáš Souček
key_players.performance_stats: The indispensable midfield engine. Played 39 matches (2532 minutes) in the 25/26 season, registering 6 goals, 158 duels won, 81 aerial duels won, 78 recoveries, and 25 tackles. Celebrated as the all-time top Czech goalscorer in the Premier League.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Excluded from the squad due to a serious long-term knee injury.
